description: Unique identifier for each transaction, useful as a primary key.
Type of purchased item; includes valid items and error/unknown entries.
Number of items bought; contains numeric strings and error/unknown values.
Cost per single item unit; includes numeric strings and error/unknown values.
Total amount paid per transaction; limited distinct values and some missing.
Mode of payment used; includes valid methods and error/unknown entries.
Purchase location type; includes valid locations and error/unknown entries.
Date of transaction within 2023; some dates are missing.
